# Doctrine

Projection of `architecture/` at `core@1.0.0`.
This document is authoritative for nothing. Edit the canonical YAML instead.
## Control loop

The substrate is a loop entered at acquisition, not a stack entered at evidence.

```
acquisition -> evidence
evidence -> observation
observation -> trust
trust -> canonical_state
canonical_state -> retrieval_execution
retrieval_execution -> validation
validation -> derived_state
derived_state -> acquisition
```

The return edge is mandatory and exclusive. Forbidden edges:

- `derived_state -> evidence` -- an interpretation would become its own evidence
- `derived_state -> canonical_state` -- a proposal would assert itself
- `retrieval_execution -> evidence` -- retrieval output is not an observation
- `validation -> evidence` -- validation status is not an evidence class

## Evidence classes

Ingest classes: `asserted`, `computed`, `derived`, `measured`.

The class is fixed in the call that admits the object and there is no
reclassification path. Absence of a class is `unclassified`, which is inadmissible for canonical assertion and for training.

Presentation and query terminology maps onto those classes:

- `computed` -> `computed`
- `hypothesized` -> `derived`
- `inferred` -> `derived`
- `manufactured` -> `measured`
- `measured` -> `measured`
- `observed` -> `measured`
- `predicted` -> `computed`
- `reported` -> `asserted`
- `simulated` -> `computed`

`validated` is a claim-level status, never an evidence class. There is no promotion path from status to class.

## Roles

| Role | Behaviour | Lineage |
|---|---|---|
| builder | implementation and building | proposing |
| resolver | semantic resolution and proposal | proposing |
| scout | discovery and proposal | proposing |
| validator | acceptance and rejection | accepting |

The accepting role must be vendor-independent from the proposing lineage.
Which vendor serves which role is execution configuration and is not stated here.
Different vendors are not thereby statistically independent; the requirement is a
boundary requirement, not an independence claim.

- `unreachable_refusal_stages` -- 11 of 15 refusal codes cannot be produced by any shipped binding. 7 are structurally unreachable through the unmodified vendored pipeline and can never be exercised; the other 4 would become reachable only if an adapter or extractor changed.
